crew.title: GANTZ:O

details.biography: Kensuke Sonomura joined the Kurata Action Club when he was a student and learned the basics of stunts. After leaving the group, he worked as a freelancer before joining U'den Flamework Works in 2003. After working as a stunt actor in numerous films and tv, he made his debut as an action director with LOVE DEATH. Since then, he has been working as an action director in a wide range of genres including movies, TV, and games.
details.name: Kensuke Sonomura
